newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB sees offshore effects on franking.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB sees offshore effects on franking.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Thursday its growing offshore earnings would have an impact on its ability to accumulate franking credits, but that dividends would continue to be fully franked for the foreseeable future.

"Obviously the more earnings that are earned offshore and don't attract Auxtralian income tax will over time have a diminishing effect on our franking credits," NAB Chairman William Irvine told the group's annual meeting.
"But we are very comfortable that in the foreseeable future...that we will have the capacity to frank dividends in full. That of course, may not necessary continue forever," he said.
NAB paid a 87 cents per share fully-franked dividend in the year to September 30.
